verdict.rationale: Stable's docs say users can create and manage API keys in the dashboard and authenticate with the x-api-key header. Nothing indicates those keys can be scoped, restricted to specific resources or actions, or issued with least-privilege permissions for an agent. The 'custom roles and permissions' claim covers team mail routing for users, not API credential scoping, so it is only an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: You can create and manage your own API keys directly in the dashboard under Settings > API keys
Authentication to the Stable API is performed via the x-api-key header.
Make sure the right team gets the right mail with custom roles and permissions.
